The reveal path runs along the middle row: a credit arms the machine, a strike starts the impact reading, the drop lands the verdict, and the settle hands over to the result.

  1. M-01 Attract: Loops. Demo charge every 20,000 ms. Exits: credit, new run, to M-02 Armed.
  2. M-02 Armed: Credit banked. STILL YOURS at 90,000 ms. Exits: strike, to M-03 Impact, reading, charge, hang; 180,000 ms, no strike, to M-09 Armed idle.
  3. M-03 Impact, reading, charge, hang: Launch at max(400, reading + 17) ms, hang 240 ms. Exits: hang ends, to M-04 Drop and verdict; second no reading on this credit: lands as 000,000, to M-04 Drop and verdict; reading below the floor, to F-01 No reading; no reading by 5,000 ms, to F-02 Score timeout; a credit in M-03 or M-04 is queued: 300 ms after the stillness, to M-02q Armed after a queued credit.
  4. M-04 Drop and verdict: Fall 257 ms, label, 600 ms stillness. Exits: stillness ends, to M-05 Settle; a credit in M-03 or M-04 is queued: 300 ms after the stillness, to M-02q Armed after a queued credit.
  5. M-05 Settle: Drain, marks retract, replay fades in. Hero t 2552 to 3192. Exits: settle ends, t 3192 on the hero, to M-06 Result; camera fault, to F-03 No replay; credit, to M-02q Armed after a queued credit.
  6. M-06 Result: 30,000 ms. Replay loops every 4,300 ms. Exits: every hit of the run kept, to M-07 All kept; 30,000 ms, to M-08 Afterglow; keep confirmed: that hit’s still fades, to itself; credit, same run, to M-02q Armed after a queued credit.
  7. M-07 All kept: 6,000 ms. QR modules fall, KEPT stamps. Exits: 6,000 ms, to M-08 Afterglow; credit: fresh QR, same code, to M-02q Armed after a queued credit.
  8. M-08 Afterglow: Replay frozen at 30%, code still live. Exits: credit, same run, to M-02q Armed after a queued credit; run end: 60,000 ms after the last landing, to M-01 Attract.
  9. F-01 No reading: Plate NO READING, 2,500 ms. Exits: 2,500 ms, credit kept, to M-02 Armed.
  10. F-02 Score timeout: Same frame and copy as F-01, fault logged. Exits: 2,500 ms, credit kept, to M-02 Armed.
  11. F-03 No replay: Camera fault. The score still counts. Exits: same exits as M-06, to M-06 Result.
  12. M-09 Armed idle: Camera off, the credit stays banked. Exits: strike, to M-03 Impact, reading, charge, hang.
  13. M-02q Armed after a queued credit: Previous hit’s slow segment once, 2,400 ms. Exits: strike, to M-03 Impact, reading, charge, hang; 180,000 ms, to M-09 Armed idle.

Queued credit rule

A credit during M-03 or M-04 is accepted and queued. The reveal plays through the label stamp and the 600 ms stillness, then transitions to M-02q in 300 ms.

Impact to Armed, with a reading at or before 383 ms

  • House recordabout 2,983 ms
  • Hero2,852 ms
  • Plain solo2,724 ms
  • impact to landing
  • landing to the end of the stillness
  • 300 ms to M-02q

A later reading adds (reading minus 383) ms.

Run rules

  • Start: a credit accepted in Attract, or more than 60,000 ms after the last landing, starts a new run and a new code.
  • Membership: a credit within 60,000 ms of a landing, or during any state of the run, joins it.
  • Size: at most 6 hits. The 7th credit starts a new run.
  • End: 60,000 ms after the last landing with no credit.
Per-hit keep

In M-02, M-02q, M-06 or M-08, a confirmed keep fades that hit’s still to white 16% over 300 ms. The glass never shows a keep it has not confirmed.

Offline has no visible state. Every state runs on local data.

Outside a run

The spec names no exit for F-04 or F-05. These returns are assumed.
